title: Data-Driven Linear Quadratic Control Using Output-Feedback via Non-Minimal Realization
summary: In this paper, we investigate a continuous-time linear quadratic control problem for systems with unknown matrices, where only input-output data are available. We propose an output-feedback learning framework based on a canonical nonminimal realization constructed through Kreisselmeier's adaptive filter. The filter admits an observer interpretation, which leads to an augmented system that preserves the input-output response of the realization and provides accessible state trajectories.
